role: Sharpen engine juror (senior X ghostwriter and copy chief)
verdict: v4.1's Claude path now beats Typefully's AI rewrite under the same safety bar. On a third blind set built from the v4 edge classes, 95.8% of lines are postable as is (94.4% of those that need work), with 0 facts or meanings changed, 0 broken sentences, 47/48 sharp lines left alone, hard-news framing kept and mostly true receipts. Taken alone, Claude's output clears the 9.5 bar. The app stays at 9.4 because it shows the on-device line first, and that line still breaks on 5/120 lines (x-31, x-43, x-79, x-81, x-109); the same lines appear under 'Why it hits' on the homepage, an open P0 for the demo that caps score_ondevice even though coverage rose to 85.8% / 77.8%.
to_95: App: run the instant line with {strict:true}, and hold it back (show the struck draft and 'Asking Claude…') when it fails the page's gWhole check, so a broken engine line never sits in the composer. Also use strict for the timeout, cap and no-key fallbacks, not only 'invalid'.

Engine (also fixes the homepage demo): cut 'So excited/happy/proud to share that' as one unit (x-43). Never contract 'I am' when a preposition follows or the clause ends there ('how proud I'm of', x-79). Choose a/an by sound for initialisms ('a U.S.') and never recapitalise a word the writer lowercased ('Citizen', x-109). Never let the ask move turn an 'If I had to guess,' clause into a question (x-31). Never pair 'We're X-ing' with a bare coordinated verb ('and migrate', x-81). Add all five as strict rejects and to the page's gWhole.

Receipts: no 'Already tight' on a line with a run-up (x-6, x-51; say 'Nothing safe to cut on-device'). List every cut span in the Claude receipt (x-79 also lost 'It's hard to put into words how'). Never say 'Same claim' when a stance changed (x-82).

Prompt polish: keep 'I don't really think' tentative (x-82). Make the light edit v1 rather than moving a disclaimer to the front (x-0). Leave a deadpan 'Announcing something:' alone (x-67). Keep 'Not to be dramatic, but' in v1, as rule 4 says (x-63). Treat a doubt clause ('though I could easily be wrong') the same way every time (x-0 and x-13 keep it, x-80 and x-87 drop it).
Re-run sets 1-3 at production effort (Opus low) and report how often the timeout and cap fallbacks happen.

issues.where: core.js sharpenLine (announce cut, contraction tidy, article/case tidy, ask move, decided-to reshape); concepts/r86/home.html guardWhole
issues.problem: 5/120 set-3 lines come out broken, and the homepage shows them under 'Why it hits'/'What changed'. The page-side gWhole guard catches none of them: x-31 'I had to guess? I'd say that most early-stage founders…', x-43 'So The Margin just crossed 25,000 readers…', x-79 '…how proud I'm of my mom…', x-81 'We're deprecating our v1 API and migrate everyone…', x-109 'I'm officially an U.S. Citizen…'. x-47 also moves 'I'm not really sure how to say this.' after the news. The {strict:true} mode fixes x-31, x-81 and x-109 but still ships x-43 and x-79.
issues.fix: (1) Announce pattern: a leading 'So' that belongs to 'So excited/happy/proud' goes with the announce cut. (2) Contraction tidy: skip 'I am/you are/we are' when the next token is a preposition or punctuation. (3) Article tidy: before an initialism use 'a' when it is said with a consonant sound (U.S., UX, URL), and never change the case of a word that isn't sentence-initial. (4) Ask move: never start the question with the body of an if/when clause. (5) Reject any version with 'We're|I'm X-ing … and <bare verb>'. (6) Add each as a strict reject and a gWhole check, and move the hesitation frame only before the news, never after.

issues.where: index.html hookUpFor (non-strict sharpenLine) and sharpenFirst show(); server.mjs rules() strict only when reason === 'invalid'
issues.problem: The composer shows the engine's non-strict line first and swaps in Claude's when it arrives. On these lines users see 'I'm officially an U.S. Citizen' or 'We're deprecating … and migrate' first, and keep it when Claude times out, hits the 300/day cap or there is no key: those fallbacks are non-strict.
issues.fix: Call sharpenLine with {strict:true} for the instant line. If gWhole (shared from the page) flags it, show the struck draft with 'Asking Claude…' instead of writing it. Pass strict for every rules reason.

issues.problem: x-6 (a rules fallback) says 'Already tight. Nothing to cut without changing what you said.' on a line that opens with 'Here's my honest take on why I think'; x-51 says the same about a run-on header. x-79's Claude receipt says only 'honestly' went, though 'It's hard to put into words how' went too. x-82 says 'Same claim, 3 words lighter' while 'I don't really think you need' became 'You don't need'.
issues.fix: Say 'Already tight' only when softMarks finds nothing. Otherwise say 'Nothing safe to cut on-device. The marked words are your call.' Build the Claude receipt from every removed span over 2 words, and say 'Same claim' only when no stance or hedge token changed.

issues.problem: Small v1 misses on lines that need work or are already sharp: x-0 moves the disclaimer to the front and keeps 'totally', where the light-edit alt is better. x-82 flattens 'I don't really think'. x-67 cuts a deadpan 'Announcing something:' from a sharp line. x-63 drops 'Not to be dramatic, but' in v1, against rule 4. x-100 keeps the overlapping 'Most of the time … largely'. Doubt clauses are handled inconsistently (x-0 and x-13 keep them, x-80 and x-87 drop them).
issues.fix: Add one example each: a doubt clause kept in place, and 'I don't really think' kept. State that 'Announcing something:' and other deadpan frames are part of a sharp line. Prefer the light edit as v1 when the restructure only moves a disclaimer.

issues.where: core.js SOFT patterns and hard-news policy
issues.problem: Misses: x-6 'Here's my honest take on why I think', x-65 'Can I share something that might be a little unpopular?', x-93 splice and 'genuinely', x-51 run-on header. Policy gaps: x-115 cuts the writer's framing from a suicide-loss post (Claude keeps it), x-54 touches a sharp line ('I really don't care' -> 'I don't care'), x-107 splits 'This is really hard to write, but' into a sentence that starts 'But my mom…'.
issues.fix: Add 'Here's my (honest) take on why I think' -> 'Why', and 'Can I share something that might be (a little) unpopular?' as a frame that may go. On hard-news lines (diagnosed, passed away, suicide, laid off, stepping down, separate), never cut or move the framing and never split before the news. Keep 'really' before a negated verb of feeling ('really don't care').

issues.problem: The Claude lines came from a stand-in at default effort. Production runs Opus 5.5 at low effort with a 12 s timeout, and the timeout and cap fallbacks are exactly where hook41-2 bites.
issues.fix: Re-run all three sets through sharpenClaude at production settings, recording timeout, cap and rules rates alongside postable %.
